01 / The truth

It's not you.
It's the method.

They tell you to write.

Repeat.

Copy it again.

Memorize.

Repeat again.

And just when you think you've finally learned it…

your memory hits Delete.

Not because you're bad at this.
Because that's how the brain works.

That's where

Kanjidon comes in.

02 / The beginning

There's nothing boring inside.

There's a beautiful kanji.

First, you want it.

Then, you put it to the test.

In the end, it sticks.

03 / The card

You're not filling an album.

You're building your memory.

Some show up right away.

Others make you work for them.

Collections come and go. These stay.

I

Discover.

Open. Find.
Demand another.

Curiosity takes the first step. We put it to work.

II

Remember.

The brain forgets.
We beat it to the punch.

Quizzes and SRS show up before the kanji disappears.

III

Fight.

Studying quietly was too easy.

Challenge. React. Win. Kanji needs to become a reflex.

The problem isn't remembering one kanji.

It's remembering six thousand.

That's why Kanjidon exists.

We built a world that refuses to let you get bored.

05 / The stories

Other apps feed you fake sentences. We drop you into the scene.

Step into illustrated stories. Listen. Read. Translate. Answer.

A café, a train, a message you never expected. The Japanese you practice here is the kind you'll actually run into.

You don't learn a sentence.
You find out what happens next.

06 / The stamps

The adventure is
finding
them all.

Stamps won't improve your Japanese. That's your job.

But they look damn good in your collection.

One card catches your eye.

The next one challenges you.

Then you want them all.

It's not an album. It's your memory, finally given something to crave.

07 / No shortcuts

We give you everything. You decide how far to take it.

6,000+ cards. From your first kanji to N1.

16 quiz types. Handwriting, dictation, shadowing, and plenty more.

Stories, SRS, missions, battles, stats. The complete system.

The method is ready. The path is yours.
Do whatever you want with it.

08 / The proof

The best part?

You don't have to take our word for it.

Read what happened to the people who started ‘just to try it.’
